highlights: Guest shuttles between hotels and the wedding venue
Vehicles for up to eight passengers and eight bags
Airport cars arrive 10 minutes before the agreed pick-up time
Drivers familiar with VIP terminals such as the Windsor Suite
Airport and seaport transfers available at short notice

howItWorks.title: Share your journey details
howItWorks.text: Use the online quote form to give the number of passengers, pick-up address, destination, and the date, time and any other details of the journey.

howItWorks.title: Receive a quote
howItWorks.text: T&L Executive Cars says it replies within 24 hours and aims to provide a prompt, competitive rate.

goodToKnow.text: The quote form asks for the number of passengers, the pick-up address, the destination, and the date and time of travel.
Luggage space varies by vehicle: the Mercedes E Class and S Class each take three bags, the V Class seven, and the custom executive vehicle eight.
A chaperone to the airport check-in desk is available, but it needs to be requested at the time of booking.
On departures, the business monitors traffic conditions to keep the journey running smoothly; on arrivals, it tracks the flight so the driver knows the precise landing time.
No prices are published; the business provides a rate once it has the details of the journey.
The office is open Monday to Friday, 9.00am to 6.30pm.

faqs.q: Can you transport wedding guests as well as the couple?
faqs.a: Yes. Alongside wedding cars, the business runs a logistics service taking guests between their hotels and the venue, which it describes as very popular and cost-effective.

faqs.q: How many passengers can each car take?
faqs.a: The Mercedes E Class and S Class each seat four passengers, the Mercedes V Class seats seven, and the Toureno Custom Executive Spec seats eight.

All London airports, including Heathrow, Gatwick, London City, Luton, Stansted and Southend. Drivers also know the VIP areas, including the Windsor Suite, Harrods Air, Tag Aviation, Signature and the Diamond Hangar.
Yes. The business monitors the flight so the driver knows the precise arrival time, then welcomes passengers in the arrivals terminal with a full meet-and-greet service.

faqs.q: Will the car display private hire plates?
faqs.a: No. The business says its vehicles are certificated as exempt from displaying a private hire plate, which allows a discreet service.

faqs.q: Can you collect us from a cruise terminal?
faqs.a: Yes. The driver helps with luggage on the way out and waits in arrivals for the return journey. Southampton's cruise terminals are covered, along with Harwich, Tilbury, Ramsgate, Dover and Swansea.
Accepted payment methods include Visa, MasterCard, American Express and Apple Pay.

serviceDetails.name: Wedding Transport
serviceDetails.more: The business says hiring a wedding car does not need to be expensive, and offers a number of options it describes as very competitive and affordable.

serviceDetails.name: Special Events & Days Out
serviceDetails.more: The homepage says special-event transfers can be easily arranged, and the business aims to make each one seamless and enjoyable.

serviceDetails.name: Corporate Services
serviceDetails.more: The service is customised by working closely with each client and is offered at what the business calls an affordable price. Not displaying licensing logos helps present the professional image a business needs.

serviceDetails.name: Media & Speaker Transfers
serviceDetails.more: The speakers transferred for London speaking bureaux range from industry leaders and senior politicians to motivational speakers and broadcasters.

serviceDetails.name: Airport Transfers
serviceDetails.more: On departures, the car arrives at the home or business 10 minutes before the agreed time. Drivers are familiar with VIP areas including the Windsor Suite, Harrods Air, Tag Aviation, Signature and the Diamond Hangar.

serviceDetails.name: Seaport & Cruise Terminal Transfers
serviceDetails.more: The homepage says seaport transfers can be offered at short notice.

notes: Fetched 27 Oct 2026. The site has only five public pages (plus privacy and cookie policies) and no FAQ, terms, cancellation, deposit or waiting-time policy, so none could be verified. No prices are published; the 'no prices' goodToKnow paraphrases the homepage line inviting customers to send journey details for 'a prompt and competitive rate'. Wedding car styling (ribbons, decoration, chauffeur dress), child seats and maximum fleet size per wedding are not stated. The site's client testimonials and client-logo strip were not used.
